title: Bill Clinton: Survivor
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来“美国总统”系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about William Jefferson Clinton – better known as Bill Clinton.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来讲威廉·杰斐逊·克林顿——他更广为人知的名字是比尔·克林顿。

sentences.en: Clinton took office in 1993, and was re-elected in 1996.
sentences.zh: 克林顿于1993年就职，并在1996年连任。

sentences.en: In many ways, historians consider his time in office a success.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，历史学家认为他的执政是一段成功的岁月。

sentences.en: The economy expanded, and the country was largely at peace.
sentences.zh: 经济得以扩张，国家大体上处于和平之中。

sentences.en: But Clinton had some notable failures, too.
sentences.zh: 不过，克林顿也有一些引人注目的失败。

sentences.en: He could not persuade Congress to accept a plan to reform the nation’s health care system.
sentences.zh: 他未能说服国会接受一项改革国家医疗体系的计划。

sentences.en: And, in his second term, the House of Representatives took steps to remove him from office.
sentences.zh: 而且，在他的第二个任期内，众议院采取了步骤，试图将他免职。

sentences.en: But the Senate decided not to act.
sentences.zh: 但参议院决定不予行动。

sentences.en: Clinton finished his second term with high approval ratings.
sentences.zh: 克林顿以高支持率结束了他的第二个任期。

sentences.en: Yet he is also remembered for being only the second U.S. president to be impeached.
sentences.zh: 然而，他同样因成为第二位被弹劾的美国总统而为人铭记。

sentences.en: Bill Clinton came from a town with a memorable name: Hope.
sentences.zh: 比尔·克林顿出生在一个名字令人难忘的小镇：霍普。

sentences.en: He grew up there, and in another nearby town in the Southern state of Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 他在那里长大，也在南方阿肯色州附近另一座小镇长大。

sentences.en: For most of his early life, Bill was raised by his grandmother and his mother, both nurses.
sentences.zh: 在他生命的早年，比尔主要由他的祖母和母亲抚养长大，两人都是护士。

sentences.en: His father had died in a car accident before he was born.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在他出生前的一场车祸中去世。

sentences.en: People who knew Bill as a young man remember him as very intelligent, charming with people, and talented in music.
sentences.zh: 熟悉青年比尔的人记得他非常聪明，待人亲切迷人，且在音乐方面很有才华。

sentences.en: His mother told him he would be president one day.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲告诉他，他总有一天会成为总统。

sentences.en: Sure enough, Clinton pursued activities that would lead to a political career.
sentences.zh: 果然如此，克林顿从事了一系列能够通向政治生涯的活动。

sentences.en: He attended college at Georgetown University in Washington, DC, where he studied international affairs; led student government groups; and took a position as a clerk in the U.S. Senate.
sentences.zh: 他就读于华盛顿特区的乔治城大学，学习国际事务；领导学生政府组织；并担任美国议院的一名书记员。

sentences.en: He went on to study at Oxford University in England on a prestigious Rhodes Scholarship.
sentences.zh: 随后，他凭借享有盛誉的罗兹奖学金前往英国牛津大学深造。

sentences.en: Then he graduated from law school at Yale University.
sentences.zh: 随后，他从耶鲁大学法学院毕业。

sentences.en: There, he met another student who would be his wife, Hillary Rodham.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他遇到了另一位学生，她后来成为了他的妻子希拉里·罗德姆。

sentences.en: The two went on to have one child together, a daughter named Chelsea.
sentences.zh: 两人育有一个孩子，一个名叫切尔西的女儿。

sentences.en: After finishing his studies, Clinton returned to his home state of Arkansas and pursued political office.
sentences.zh: 完成学业后，克林顿回到家乡阿肯色州，投身政治竞选。

sentences.en: At 32, he became one of the youngest governors ever in the country.
sentences.zh: 32岁时，他成为全美最年轻的州长之一。

sentences.en: Two years later, he was voted out of office, and -- as historian Russell Riley notes -- he became the youngest former governor.
sentences.zh: 两年后，他落选下台，——正如历史学家拉塞尔·莱利所指出的——他成了最年轻的卸任州长。

sentences.en: And that is how a good deal of Clinton’s political career continued: in a pattern of successes and failures.
sentences.zh: 克林顿的许多政治生涯正是如此延续的：呈现出成功与失败交替的模式。

sentences.en: His successes often came as a result of his centrist policies, which appealed to people of different political beliefs.
sentences.zh: 他的成功往往源于其中间派政策，这吸引了不同政治信仰的人们。

sentences.en: He also was an effective public speaker and, to many, a likable, charismatic person who seemed to care deeply about others.
sentences.zh: 他也是卓有成效的演说家，在许多人眼中，他是一个讨人喜欢、富有魅力的人，似乎非常关心他人。

sentences.en: But, his critics pointed out, Clinton also appeared to make many decisions simply for political advantage.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的批评者指出，克林顿似乎常常仅仅为了政治利益而做出许多决定。

sentences.en: And he sometimes tried to please so many people that he pleased no one.
sentences.zh: 有时他试图讨好太多人，结果却谁也没讨好。

sentences.en: Following a series of increasingly national roles – as well as a series of setbacks – Clinton campaigned for president in 1992.
sentences.zh: 经历了一系列日益重要的全国性职务——以及一连串挫折之后，克林顿在1992年竞选总统。

sentences.en: At first, he did not do well in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 起初，他在竞选中表现不佳。

sentences.en: He was young and not well-known.
sentences.zh: 他年轻，也不为人所知。

sentences.en: He also suffered from reports that he had relationships with women who were not his wife.
sentences.zh: 他还因有关他与非妻子身份的女性有染的报道而受损。

sentences.en: But in time, Clinton began winning primary contests.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，克林顿开始在初选中获胜。

sentences.en: Reporters called him the “Comeback Kid.”
sentences.zh: 记者们称他为“回归小子”。

sentences.en: He earned a public image as a politician who could survive problems.
sentences.zh: 他树立起一个能够逢凶化吉的政治家形象。

sentences.en: In the general election, Clinton competed against the sitting president, Republican George H.W. Bush.
sentences.zh: 在大选中，克林顿对阵时任总统、共和党人乔治·H·W·布什。

sentences.en: The two men also faced an unusually strong third-party candidate named Ross Perot.
sentences.zh: 这两位候选人还遭遇了一位实力异常强劲的第三方候选人罗斯·佩罗。

sentences.en: On Election Night, Clinton prevailed.
sentences.zh: 在选举之夜，克林顿胜出。

sentences.en: Because Americans had split their votes among three major candidates, Clinton earned less than 50% of the popular vote.
sentences.zh: 由于美国选民把票分散投给了三位主要候选人，克林顿获得的普选票不足50%。

sentences.en: But he won enough electoral votes to become the next U.S. president.
sentences.zh: 但他赢得了足够的选举人票，成为下一任美国总统。

sentences.en: The people who worked on Bill Clinton’s presidential campaign adopted an informal motto.
sentences.zh: 为比尔·克林顿的总统竞选工作的人们采用了一条非正式的口号。

sentences.en: They said, “It’s the economy, stupid.”
sentences.zh: 他们说：“笨蛋，关键是经济。”

sentences.en: In other words, campaign officials believed that most Americans cared primarily about how a president’s policies would affect their financial concerns.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，竞选官员认为大多数美国人民主要关心的是总统的政策将如何影响他们的经济问题。

sentences.en: So, President Clinton quickly set about making a series of economic changes.
sentences.zh: 因此，克林顿总统着手推行一系列经济变革。

sentences.en: They included raising taxes on wealthier Americans and cutting spending to help poorer Americans.
sentences.zh: 这些变革包括向更富有的美国人民增税，并削减开支以帮助更贫困的美国人民。

sentences.en: In a few years, the U.S. budget deficit was gone, the federal government had a surplus, and the country’s financial situation was strong and healthy – although not everyone approved of the steps Clinton took to get there, or believed he should get all the credit.
sentences.zh: 几年之内，美国预算赤字消失了，联邦政府有了盈余，国家的财政状况变得强劲而健康——尽管并非所有人都赞同克林顿为实现这一目标所采取的措施，或认为他应当获得全部功劳。

sentences.en: Early in his first term, Clinton sought an additional reform he believed would help voters’ financial concerns: affordable health insurance for all Americans.
sentences.zh: 在第一个任期的初期，克林顿寻求一项他认为有助于解决选民经济问题的改革：让所有美国人民都能负担得起的医疗保险。

sentences.en: Most people in the U.S. either bought private health insurance or did not have any insurance to help pay for medical costs.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国人民要么购买私人医疗保险，要么没有任何保险来支付医疗费用。

sentences.en: Clinton wanted to find a way for the U.S. government to support Americans’ health-related expenses.
sentences.zh: 克林顿想找到一种让美国政府支持美国人民相关医疗开支的办法。

sentences.en: He appointed his wife, first lady Hillary Clinton, to lead a healthcare reform effort.
sentences.zh: 他任命自己的妻子、第一夫人希拉里·克林顿领导一项医疗改革工作。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton, a lawyer, had led a similar effort to reform education in Arkansas when her husband was governor there.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿是一名律师，在丈夫担任阿肯色州州长期间，曾领导过一项类似的改革教育的努力。

sentences.en: But some lawmakers in Congress – as well as some voters – rejected her efforts.
sentences.zh: 但国会中的一些立法者——以及一些选民——拒绝了她的工作。

sentences.en: The reform effort failed.
sentences.zh: 这项改革努力失败了。

sentences.en: Clinton also struggled in some early foreign policy moves.
sentences.zh: 克林顿在一些早期的外交政策举措上也举步维艰。

sentences.en: He withdrew American troops from Somalia after their humanitarian efforts there turned into a bloody military struggle.
sentences.zh: 在索马里的救援行动演变成一场血腥的军事冲突后，他撤回了美国驻军。

sentences.en: He was also criticized for failing to intervene quickly in the genocide in Rwanda, where hundreds of thousands of people were killed.
sentences.zh: 他还因未能迅速介入卢旺达种族灭绝事件而受到批评，当时有数十万人被杀。

sentences.en: Later, Clinton won praise for some of his foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 后来，克林顿因其部分外交政策而获得赞誉。

sentences.en: His government helped restore the elected president in Haiti after a coup.
sentences.zh: 他的政府在海地发生政变后帮助恢复了民选总统。

sentences.en: It also helped negotiate peace agreements in Bosnia and Ireland.
sentences.zh: 它还帮助在波斯尼亚和爱尔兰谈判达成和平协议。

sentences.en: And it cooperated with NATO to intervene in the Kosovo area and stop attacks on Albanians there.
sentences.zh: 它与北约合作，干预科索沃地区局势，阻止对当地阿尔巴尼亚人的袭击。

sentences.en: In general, Clinton believed the U.S. had an important role to play in maintaining peace and protecting human life around the world.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，克林顿认为美国在维护世界和平、保护人类生命方面扮演着重要角色。

sentences.en: At the same time, he did not want to use too many American resources to do so.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他并不想为此动用过多的美国资源。

sentences.en: He aimed to cooperate with other nations, and to set moderate goals.
sentences.zh: 他的目标是与其他国家合作，并设定适度的目标。

sentences.en: As usual, Clinton adopted an approach that was not too extreme on one side or another.
sentences.zh: 与往常一样，克林顿采取了一种不过分偏袒任何一方的做法。

sentences.en: During most of his time as president, Clinton had been under investigation.
sentences.zh: 在他担任总统的大部分时间里，他一直在接受调查。

sentences.en: Federal judges had appointed a special counsel, named Kenneth Starr, to find out if the president had committed any crimes related to financial investments before he took office.
sentences.zh: 联邦法官任命了名为肯尼斯·斯塔尔的特别检察官，以查明总统在就职前是否犯有任何与金融投资相关的罪行。

sentences.en: During the investigation, Starr learned that the president had been having a sexual relationship with a young woman who worked in the White House.
sentences.zh: 在调查过程中，斯塔尔得知总统与一名在白宫工作的年轻女子有性关系。

sentences.en: Starr asked Clinton about the affair under oath.
sentences.zh: 斯塔尔在宣誓后向克林顿询问了这段婚外情。

sentences.en: Later, Starr accused Clinton of lying about his relationship with the woman.
sentences.zh: 后来，斯塔尔指控克林顿就他与该女子的关系说谎。

sentences.en: Starr said that Clinton had also tried to prevent others from telling the truth about some of his activities.
sentences.zh: 斯塔尔称，克林顿还试图阻止他人就他的某些行为说出真相。

sentences.en: In time, the president publicly admitted the relationship, and he apologized to voters and his family.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，总统公开承认了这段关系，并向选民和家人道歉。

sentences.en: But he said he had not lied or told anyone else to lie for him.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，自己没有说谎，也没有指使他人替他撒谎。

sentences.en: Lawmakers in the House of Representatives did not accept Clinton’s defense.
sentences.zh: 众议院的议员们不接受克林顿的辩解。

sentences.en: They advanced two articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 他们提出了两项弹劾条款。

sentences.en: Lawmakers in the U.S. Senate then considered the case.
sentences.zh: 随后，美国参议院的议员们开始审理此案。

sentences.en: It is their job to examine the evidence and decide whether to remove a president from office.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作是审查证据，并决定是否将总统免职。

sentences.en: A majority did not believe the actions Clinton was accused of were serious violations against the country.
sentences.zh: 多数议员认为，克林顿被指控的行为并不构成对该国的严重违反。

sentences.en: They voted to acquit Clinton of the charges and permit him to continue as president.
sentences.zh: 他们投票裁定克林顿无罪，并允许他继续担任总统。

sentences.en: In the U.S., a president can serve only two full terms.
sentences.zh: 在美国，总统只能担任两个完整任期。

sentences.en: After his second, Bill Clinton and his wife settled in a town outside New York City.
sentences.zh: 在第二个任期结束后，比尔·克林顿和妻子定居在纽约市郊的一个小镇。

sentences.en: In time, Hillary Clinton became the U.S. senator from New York, as well as a secretary of state and the Democratic Party’s candidate for president.
sentences.zh: 后来，希拉里·克林顿成为来自纽约州的美国参议员，还出任国务卿，并当选民主党总统候选人。

sentences.en: Bill Clinton, like many other U.S. presidents, wrote about his experiences and helped develop his presidential library.
sentences.zh: 比尔·克林顿像许多其他美国总统一样，撰写了自己经历的书，并协助建设他的总统图书馆。

sentences.en: He also worked on humanitarian, health, and economic issues with his family’s organization, the Clinton Foundation.
sentences.zh: 他还通过其家族设立的克林顿基金会，致力于人道主义、健康和经济问题。

sentences.en: For many, Clinton’s time in office is remembered as a mixed experience.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，克林顿在位时期被铭记为一段喜忧参半的经历。

sentences.en: The economy was at one of its strongest in U.S. history.
sentences.zh: 当时美国经济处于美国历史上最强盛的时期之一。

sentences.en: Most people could find jobs, and many Americans bought homes for the first time.
sentences.zh: 大多数人能找到工作，许多美国人第一次买到了自己的住房。

sentences.en: In the mid-1990s especially, the Internet and other new developments created a technology boom.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在20世纪90年代中期，互联网和其他新技术的发展催生了一场科技热潮。

sentences.en: In addition, Clinton was an effective public speaker, and he inspired new groups of people to support his Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 此外，克林顿是一位卓有成效的公众演说家，他激励了新的群体来支持他的民主党。

sentences.en: Many voters approved of his appointments of women and minorities to positions of power in his government.
sentences.zh: 许多选民赞同他任命女性和少数族裔担任政府要职。

sentences.en: They also liked the steps he took to reduce the use of handguns, protect the environment, and provide paid time off work for some people to care for themselves or their families.
sentences.zh: 他们同样喜欢他采取的各项措施，包括减少手枪的使用、保护环境，以及为部分人提供带薪假期以照顾自己或家人。

sentences.en: But both Democrats and Republicans found fault with some of Clinton’s efforts.
sentences.zh: 但民主党人和共和党人都发现克林顿的一些努力存在问题。

sentences.en: And even his supporters note that the president had to spend much of his time in office answering charges of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 就连他的支持者也指出，这位总统不得不在任内花费大量时间来回应各项不当行为的指控。

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。

glossary.def: to charge (a public official) with a crime done while in office
glossary.zh: 弹劾；指控公职人员渎职

glossary.def: a person whose job is to keep track of records and documents for a business or office
having political opinions that are not extreme; having beliefs fall between those of liberals and conservatives
glossary.zh: 中间派；主张温和不极端的
